evidence.detail: cards2_api() accepts no maindeck/sideboard parameter; the docstring lists all accepted params and none relate to deck position
The SQL uses 'SELECT DISTINCT card, deck_id FROM deck_card' specifically to avoid maindeck/sideboard double-counting — the stats tables aggregate both together
cardtable.jsx renders no maindeck/sideboard/both radio UI
No results — radio control not implemented anywhere

triage.notes: The preaggregate tables (_card_stats, _card_person_stats, _card_archetype_stats) combine maindeck and sideboard counts via DISTINCT. Supporting the filter requires either new/modified preaggregate tables or a live-query path, plus API and JSX changes — too large for easy-fix.
